faq.question: What does Samir mean?
faq.answer: Samir is associated with the Arabic form سَمِير, whose core sense is samir; evening companion.

faq.question: What is the origin of Samir?
faq.answer: Samir is associated with Arabic. Samir is Arabic سَمِير (Samīr), denoting a companion in evening talk.

faq.question: Is Samir an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form سَمِير is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Samir an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Samir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Samir a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Samir should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Samīr is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.question: What does Samir mean in Urdu?
faq.answer: In Urdu, Samir is rendered سمیر and carries the sense سمیر، رات کا ساتھی.

faq.question: What does Samir mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Samir is rendered سمیر and carries the sense سمیر، هم‌صحبت شب.

faq.question: How is Samir pronounced?
faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is sa-mir. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.question: What are the variants of Samir?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Samir, samir. Script forms are سمير, سمیر, سَمِير, समीर.

faq.question: Is Samir a boy's or girl's name?
faq.answer: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
